routing: Unchanged release chain.route and minimum 900 genuine new saved-coordinate characters. New packing deduplicates original view ranges before the conditional gate.
primary_metric: Paired first-pass clipped Brier across all five questions; raw probability, log loss and classification accuracy also reported.
secondary_metric: Paired final clipped Brier using the bounded conditional reread.
analysis_policy: Frozen Mercury model, endpoint, question registry, instructions, routing thresholds and clipping. No fitted calibration, paid fallback or score fusion.
source_policy: Existing immutable saved bundle only; no search, fetch, new supplement, metadata backfill or forecast submission.
scope: Development retrospective paired scoring, not leakage-free forecasting or a held-out evaluation. Four No and one Yes labels. One stochastic outcome per route.
failure_policy: Persist every reserved request. Preserve a validated first result if conditional rereading fails. No synthetic forecast or silent rerun. Same-request successful responses may be reused.
